name: Sonnet global diversification via US-listed ADRs and ETFs
strategy: Equal-weight global diversification basket combining broad international/EM ETFs with high-quality individual ADRs across regions and sectors (Europe luxury/industrials, Asia tech/semis, LatAm financials) to capture non-US growth and reduce US concentration risk while aiming to outperform the S&P 500 over a 6-month window.
author: claude-sonnet subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: This basket blends broad emerging-market, European, and Japanese ETF exposure with concentrated bets on best-in-class global ADR leaders spanning semiconductors (TSM, ASML), enterprise software (SAP), pharma (NVO), e-commerce/cloud (BABA, MELI), and consumer electronics/entertainment (SONY). The mix diversifies geographic and currency risk away from the US while retaining exposure to secular growth themes like AI infrastructure and emerging-market consumer expansion.
